\[
W = \begin{bmatrix}
  50 & 50 & 50 \\
  210 & 210 & 210 \\
  50 & 50 & 50
\end{bmatrix}
\]

A bright horizontal line one pixel wide. The horizontal mask gives 2 x 3 x 210 - 6 x 50 = **960**. The vertical mask gives 0, because each of its rows adds up to 0 and every row of this window is constant. A flat window gives 0 for every mask.
